title: Shani Dev aur Hanuman ji ki Katha
style: 3D animated devotional movie style, Pixar quality, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm colours, no text, no letters, no writing
hook: Shani Dev Lanka mein kaid kyun the?

scenes.prompt: Dark dungeon in golden Lanka, Shani Dev with dark blue-black skin, crown and simple dark robes, hanging upside down in chains, looking tired but calm, dim torchlight, cinematic
scenes.tts: शनि देव लंका की कालकोठरी में उल्टे बंधे थे। कौन उन्हें छुड़ाएगा?
scenes.sub: Shani Dev Lanka ki kaalkothri mein ulte bandhe the. Kaun unhe chhudayega?

scenes.prompt: Ten-headed King Ravana in a grand golden palace of Lanka, wearing a crown and heavy jewellery, proudly ordering his guards, nine planet deities shown as small glowing figures in the background, dramatic lighting
scenes.tts: अहंकारी रावण ने नवग्रहों को अपने वश में करना चाहा था।
scenes.sub: Ahankari Ravan ne navgrahon ko apne vash mein karna chaha tha.

scenes.prompt: Lord Hanuman, saffron-orange skin, mace on shoulder, golden crown and earrings, a devoted calm face, walking through the glowing city of Lanka at night, searching for Mata Sita, warm lantern light
scenes.tts: माता सीता की खोज में हनुमान जी लंका पहुँचे।
scenes.sub: Mata Sita ki khoj mein Hanuman ji Lanka pahunche.

scenes.prompt: Lord Hanuman gently breaking the chains of Shani Dev in the dungeon, Shani Dev lowering to the ground with folded hands and gratitude, soft golden light filling the dark room
scenes.tts: हनुमान जी ने शनि देव की जंजीरें खोलकर उन्हें मुक्त किया।
scenes.sub: Hanuman ji ne Shani Dev ki janjeeren kholkar unhe mukt kiya.

scenes.prompt: Shani Dev with folded hands bowing before Lord Hanuman, giving a gentle blessing, both standing on a calm hilltop at sunrise, warm peaceful colours, glowing aura around them
scenes.tts: शनि देव बोले, आपके भक्तों को मैं कभी कष्ट नहीं दूँगा।
scenes.sub: Shani Dev bole, aapke bhakton ko main kabhi kasht nahi dunga.

scenes.tts: ॐ शं शनैश्चराय नमः। कथा अच्छी लगी हो तो लाइक, शेयर और सब्सक्राइब करें।
scenes.sub: Om Sham Shanaishcharaya Namah. Katha achhi lagi ho to Like, Share aur Subscribe karein · Shyam Premi SN
